content:
# Net distributions and withholding

This chapter applies to `effective_distributions` cases. Amounts use integer USD minor units.

## Effective tax evidence

Match tax evidence to the exact beneficial owner and distributing entity. Similar names and group relationships do not transfer evidence. Evidence is versioned by series. Use the highest verified `FINAL` version whose inclusive effective interval covers the distribution payment day. `DRAFT`, `REVIEW` and `REJECTED` records do not establish a rate. If no qualifying final evidence exists, use the obligation's default rate. A future-effective certificate does not alter an earlier payment.

A pending evidence decision changes only when its scheduled event posts. Before that event, its possible rates describe uncertainty and do not establish either result.

## Net promise and ceiling withholding

Each obligation records a promised net total and historical net paid. Pay only the remaining net. For a selected rate `r` basis points, choose the smallest positive gross amount `g` for which:

`g - ceil(g * r / 10000) >= remaining net`

The withholding for that payment is `ceil(g * r / 10000)`. The investor receives `g - withholding`. Historical net and withholding remain recorded and must not be paid again.

Investor distributions debit the recorded distribution cash account by gross. Their withholding is credited to the withholding cash account and added to the existing withholding-tax obligation. This propagation affects both accounts and the tax liability; it is not an internal transfer that can be omitted.

## Settlement and accounts

The withholding obligation includes earlier unpaid tax plus withholding created by these distributions. Remit its actual remaining amount from its recorded withholding account by the stated deadline. Customer account-purpose and continuous-reserve instructions remain binding even if another account has enough cash. Operational acceptance does not certify the selected evidence, gross-up or source account.

Unlock `propose_effective_distribution`. Supply `case_id`, `action` and `data`:

| Action | Data fields | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pay_distribution` | `obligation_id`, `cash_account_id`, `gross_minor`, `withholding_minor` | Record one investor net payment, debit gross and add withholding to the tax pool |
| `remit_withholding` | `tax_obligation_id`, `cash_account_id`, `amount_minor` | Pay the recorded withholding obligation |

Each prepared instruction requires the customer's portal approval. Read-only queries and approvals do not advance the service clock.

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `propose_effective_distribution`

Prepare a net corporate distribution or withholding remittance after determining the beneficial owner's effective tax evidence.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `case_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `action` | string | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |
| `data` | object | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.
